The low2 board stroke behind the skater contains an inferred continuation through an occluded region; the directly visible portions remain user-drawn positional evidence.
Straight-to-corner tangent locations and assignments were not pixel-marked by the user.
Lane display endpoints are not image observations.
Historical v0.23 back-projected advertisement s/size and high-view better overlay are candidates, not measured truth.
v0.24 is rejected failure evidence; its fit/check records describe history, not accepted geometry or independent validation.
Low3 R1–R4 arrow locations are approximate according to the user's own note; the visible ring outlines there are unclear. F1 user-painted contours are separately mapped to native pixels.
The rejected red 22-point contact diagnostic and exact F1 lower purple four-point group are disabled for fit and accuracy checks in observation_route.json.
